rule: No outcome tuning. Four initial flags off; standalone one-flag sources frozen before matches. A tactic is promising only with >v10 development points, positive goal-difference delta, zero exceptions, <=2 extra raw misses/1000 and mean<=v10*1.35+.04ms. It must execute at least 5 distinct tactical episodes or passes across targeted+development. Integrate only qualifying tactics; if multiple qualify test combination on 2 unused reserve seeds then select by points (tie: fewer flags). If none qualify, freeze the highest development points standalone as an explicitly rejected best-failure challenger for required fresh qualification; tie: goal difference then flag order. No source/flag selection after qualification.
